purpose: Engineering inventory of exact locked Rust crates. Not a complete licensing clearance or binary SBOM.

scope_method.wasm_tree: cargo tree --offline --locked -p budgetbranch|demo-receiver --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -e normal,no-proc-macro; cross-checked each package against compiled wasm target .d dep-info
scope_method.host_trees: cargo tree --offline --locked --target aarch64-apple-darwin -p budgetbranch-sandbox -e normal,build; and -p budgetbranch -e all
scope_method.license_discovery: Named files in each checksum-verified archive. Legal files are hashed. Header strings are samples from the first 32 lines of text source files up to 2 MB, not exhaustive ownership determinations. Text markers are heuristic and do not assign scope. Original licenses remain in the fetched archives.
scope_method.excluded_from_crate_inventory: Compiler and sysroot, proc-macro generated code legal scope, external prebuilt Sandbox link graph, web/npm, assets.
